chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Buffalo with Eugene Primos and Jimmy Harrison, 1927-28
summary: He left Helvey for Buffalo, worked with Primos's band then Jimmy Harrison's, and listed members.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: You came to Cleveland in 1926, that you forgot, because you played down at the Globe Theatre.
When you left Helvey's band, who did you go with then?
They sent for me to come to Buffalo and I went to work with Eugene Primos' band. He had a band there. Then I left his band and worked with Jimmy Harrison's band.
The first band that you were in, in Buffalo, do you remember what year it was and who was in it?
And who was in the band?

Myself, trombone player; Eugene Primos, drums; and called him 'Jesse' Wilson. Ralph Wilson, violinist, one of the best... Let's see who else. Percy - I think it's Percy Sutton, piano player. I'm not sure, I know his first name was Percy.
And how long did you stay with that band?
Where did you travel with that band?

Oh, we played on a steady job there. So we went out up here in New York - Albany - to play a gig and that was in September. So I said, I'm so close to my mother I'll go and pay a visit. September 1928 and at 8 o'clock I had two jobs...
